Our team will transform your outdoor space in to a luxurious oasis. It isn’t just a pool…it is an experience. Get Started 3 Custom Pools View our spectacular custom pool designs that take your backyard to the next level. Learn More Outdoor Living Upgrade your outdoor living space to the paradise you’ve always wanted. Learn More Pool Remodeling We specialize in transforming outdated or worn-out pools into luxurious, modern oases. Learn More Why Choose PCR Pools & Spas? When it comes to transforming your backyard into a luxurious oasis, PCR Pools & Spas is your premier choice. We understand that deciding to build a pool is a significant commitment, both financially and emotionally. Many homeowners fear subpar craftsmanship, hidden costs, and extended timelines. At PCR, we pride ourselves on delivering not just a pool, but an experience of unparalleled quality. Every detail, from the initial design to the finishing touches, is executed with precision and dedication to doing the job the right way. Our team of experts are not only seasoned in the art of pool construction but also in ensuring your peace of mind throughout the process. By choosing PCR, you’re not just getting a pool—you’re investing in a legacy of quality, elegance, and enduring craftsmanship. Dive into confidence with PCR Pools & Spas. VIEW MORE Z Custom Pools Z Full Automation Z Splash Pads Z Outdoor Living Z Outdoor Kitchens Z Infinity Pools Z Rock Waterfalls PCR Pools & Spas What We Do At PCR Pools, we are more than just pool builders; we are creators of luxury outdoor experiences. Your project, isn’t simply another project, it becomes our mission to exceed your expectations. Our commitment runs deep, rooted in three core principles. Unwavering Quality Our name is synonymous with excellence. Every project, regardless of size, is a testament to our dedication to the highest standards of craftsmanship. We source only the best materials, ensuring longevity and pristine finishes that stand the test of time. Integrity in Execution We believe in doing things the right way, every single time. From the foundational dig to the final water fill, our team approaches every step with meticulous attention to detail. We don’t cut corners; we craft masterpieces. Innovative Design Each pool and outdoor space we design is a unique reflection of our client’s dream and our creative vision. We constantly push the boundaries of what’s possible, blending aesthetics with function, to craft spaces that are as stunning as they are enjoyable. At PCR Pools, we don’t just build pools—we craft memories, experiences, and lasting impressions. Dive into a world where quality meets creativity, and where your dreams transform into reality. Making Your Dreams Come True FAQ Few answers to some of the most common questions about pools, timelines and cost. What kind of pool is right for you? The dimensions of your property play a crucial role in deciding the size and type of pool best suited for you. However, when it comes to the pool’s shape and style, it’s all about your intended usage. If you’re looking for a pool tailored for fitness and lap swimming, then a streamlined design would be ideal. On the other hand, if you envision a serene backyard haven ideal for relaxation, entertainment, and pure leisure, a Freeform design might be just right. How much does a pool cost? Pool pricing is influenced by several variables. Typically, in-ground concrete pools carry a higher price tag compared to their fiberglass, vinyl, and above-ground counterparts. We specialize in constructing in-ground concrete pools, as they stand out for their longevity and offer unmatched versatility in design and features. Factors like the pool’s dimensions, surrounding decking, the gradient of your property (which might demand additional excavation and foundational support), and the choice of materials and finishes all play a role in determining the cost. To ensure accuracy in pricing, we recommend a personalized site visit where we can gauge your property’s specifics and understand your vision for the pool. For a commitment-free design consultation, please click here . How long does it take to build a pool? The time it takes to build your pool is ultimately dependent on the size and complexity of the design, plus any adverse weather delays. Your PCR Pools & Spas team will be able to give you an accurate estimate of time completion based on your pool design. I'm Building a Home. Should I Wait Until After We Build to Put in a Pool? Opting to construct your pool or spa in tandem with your new home offers multiple significant advantages. Foremost among these is the potential for cost savings. By integrating your pool’s expenses into your primary home mortgage, you stand to benefit from reduced financing costs. Furthermore, doing so sidesteps occasional hiccups typical to custom pool construction. If you aren’t residing in the property full-time during its construction, the usual commotion associated with building will merge unobtrusively with the ongoing home construction activities. Finally, constructing simultaneously allows for a more holistic design approach. You can effortlessly align your pool and any other outdoor features with your home’s overall design. Our design consultants are primed to collaborate with your home builder, ensuring that your backyard paradise perfectly complements your emerging dream residence. data.summary: The 20 Google reviews appear authentic in content, with specific details and varied voices. The low volume and generic, delayed owner responses are minor concerns but not strong indicators of fakery. The lack of presence on other review platforms is not a red flag for a small business.
fake_signals: Low review volume (20) for a pool contractor
Owner responses are generic and posted in batches (e.g., 'a year ago')
authentic_signals: Mentions concrete work and specific project types
Varied writing styles and reviewer profiles (Local Guide, single-review user)
Mix of praise and mentions of problem-solving (e.g., fixing existing pool issues)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has a rating. No BBB listing found, which is not unusual for a small LLC. No significant discrepancies to analyze.
